rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something physically full or packed.

example.english: The fridge is stuffed with food now.
example.jyutping: go3 syut3 gwai6 mun5 saai3 je5 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone is full because they have eaten.

example.english: I’m stuffed after eating the burger.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 go3 hon3 bou2 hou2 baau2

rows.note: Use this attributive pattern for a food item that has filling inside.

example.english: I want to eat a stuffed bun.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 jau5 haam6 ge3 baau1
